Package org.apache.spark.sql.scripting

Class SqlScriptingExecutionFrame

Object
org.apache.spark.sql.scripting.SqlScriptingExecutionFrame
All Implemented Interfaces:
scala.collection.IterableOnce<CompoundStatementExec>, scala.collection.IterableOnceOps<CompoundStatementExec,scala.collection.Iterator,scala.collection.Iterator<CompoundStatementExec>>, scala.collection.Iterator<CompoundStatementExec>
public class SqlScriptingExecutionFrame extends Object implements scala.collection.Iterator<CompoundStatementExec>
SQL scripting executor - executes script and returns result statements. This supports returning multiple result statements from a single script.

param: executionPlan CompoundBody which need to be executed. param: frameType Type of the frame. param: scopeLabel Label of the scope where handler is defined. Available only for frameType = HANDLER.
